headline: Stop pitching in your first email.
body: Lead with a specific, relevant observation about their business instead.

headline: Why it works
body: Specificity signals you did the homework. Generic pitches get deleted in two seconds.

headline: Try this instead
body: Reference something real: a launch, a hire, a product change. Then connect it to the problem you solve.

headline: Outbound that gets replies.
body: Follow for weekly breakdowns on cold email, outreach infra, and closing B2B deals.
